notes: Partition verified: 48 source and 70 target IDs each covered once across 49 units (48 source units plus one `added`).

The italic *this* (t009) is `added`: no source pronoun stands in the verbless clause, and rule 16 does not let the אֶת at s007 carry a demonstrative. The supplied *is* joins the predicate מְקוֹם under rule 20.

*neither … nor* is given to the waw as rule 14's correlative pair, headed on the closing connective, on the ground that לֹא already carries the *no* of *shall no more defile*. The competing reading applies rule 14's limit literally — a present negative takes the *neither* — which would give לֹא both *no* and *neither* as one discontinuous unit under rule 25 and leave the waw only *nor*. Both readings survive rule 42's counting, since either way one morpheme carries two words; the note names the alternative as rule 8 requires.

שָׁם is `unrepresented` under rule 22 as the resumptive of אֲשֶׁר, which takes the written *where*. The competing fusion of אֲשֶׁר … שָׁם into *where* under rules 30/35 is defeated here by rule 30's contiguity condition — the verb stands between them — which is why this verse and v. 4 come out differently.
